item.text:
**Verdict**
Mostly no. Modi’s 2024 record shows some real competition and state-firm reform signals, but the stronger pattern is opaque political finance, donor concentration, and selective anti-corruption enforcement against opponents rather than a clean resistance to capture.

**Accepted Claims**
- [Exclusive-India's Modi departs from privatisation plans, will overhaul state-run firms, sources say](https://www.thejakartapost.com/business/2024/07/12/indias-modi-departs-from-privatisation-plans-will-overhaul-state-run-firms-sources-say.html) | Reuters via The Jakarta Post | 12 Jul 2024 | Modi’s government shifted away from indiscriminate privatization toward overhauling 200+ state-run firms, monetizing idle assets, and setting long-term performance targets. That is a real, if indirect, anti-rent-seeking and anti-patronage signal. IDs: `5B.5`, `5B.4`.

- [Exclusive-India's Modi departs from privatisation plans, will overhaul state-run firms, sources say](https://theprint.in/india/exclusive-indias-modi-departs-from-privatisation-plans-will-overhaul-state-run-firms-sources-say/2171536/) | Reuters via ThePrint | 12 Jul 2024 | Same Reuters report, same underlying claim: the state sector reform plan emphasized performance and asset monetization over pure political sale-distribution. Positive, but still a policy plan rather than proof of implementation. IDs: `5B.5`, `5B.4`.

- [India probe finds Amazon, Walmart's Flipkart breached antitrust laws](https://theprint.in/india/exclusive-india-probe-finds-amazon-walmarts-flipkart-breached-antitrust-laws/2265203/) | Reuters via ThePrint | 12 Sep 2024 | India’s competition authority found preferred sellers and preferential treatment on Amazon and Flipkart, showing the regulatory state was actively policing market favoritism. This supports a limited finding that the system still resisted monopoly-style abuse. IDs: `5B.5`, `5B.4`.

- [Exclusive-India's probe finds Zomato, Swiggy breached antitrust laws, documents show](https://theprint.in/india/exclusive-indias-probe-finds-zomato-swiggy-breached-antitrust-laws-documents-show/2347697/) | Reuters via ThePrint | 8 Nov 2024 | CCI investigators found exclusivity contracts and other favoritist practices at Zomato and Swiggy. This is further evidence that competition enforcement existed, even against large, politically salient firms. IDs: `5B.5`, `5B.4`.

- [India's Modi plans post-election reforms to rival Chinese manufacturing](https://theprint.in/india/indias-modi-plans-post-election-reforms-to-rival-chinese-manufacturing/2113220/) | Reuters via ThePrint | 3 Jun 2024 | Reuters said Modi planned business-friendly reforms, including easier labor rules and lower input taxes, to improve manufacturing competitiveness. This is pro-competition evidence, though more about growth strategy than anti-corruption per se. IDs: `5B.5`, `5B.4`, `5B.1`.

- [Explainer: What were India's electoral bonds and how did they power Modi's party?](https://theprint.in/india/explainer-what-were-indias-electoral-bonds-and-how-did-they-power-modis-party/1969006/) | Reuters via ThePrint | 16 Feb 2024 | Reuters described a system of unlimited anonymous political donations that heavily benefited the BJP. This is strong evidence of opaque political finance and capture risk, not resistance to it. IDs: `5B.5`, `5B.1`, `5B.4`.

- [Obscure trust links India's top businesses with Modi's election war chest](https://theprint.in/india/obscure-trust-links-indias-top-businesses-with-modi-s-election-war-chest-2/2038095/) | Reuters via ThePrint | 12 Apr 2024 | A major electoral trust routed roughly three-quarters of its donations to the BJP, which is direct evidence of business-linked political concentration around the ruling party. IDs: `5B.5`, `5B.1`, `5B.4`.

- [Qwik, a top buyer of Indian electoral bonds, is affiliated to Ambani's Reliance, filings show](https://theprint.in/india/qwik-a-top-buyer-of-indian-electoral-bonds-is-affiliated-to-ambani-s-reliance-filings-show/2002426/) | Reuters via ThePrint | 15 Mar 2024 | Reuters reported a Reliance-affiliated company was a major electoral-bonds buyer, reinforcing the inference that politically connected business interests had privileged access. IDs: `5B.5`, `5B.1`, `5B.4`.

- [India opposition accuses government of crackdown after minister's arrest](https://theprint.in/india/india-opposition-accuses-government-of-crackdown-after-ministers-arrest/1949172/) | Reuters via ThePrint | 1 Feb 2024 | Opposition parties said the ED’s arrest of Jharkhand CM Hemant Soren showed political targeting in corruption enforcement. This is counterevidence that anti-corruption tools were being used neutrally. IDs: `5B.5`, `4B.9`.

- [India court rejects plea challenging Delhi chief minister's arrest in graft case](https://theprint.in/india/india-court-rejects-plea-challenging-delhi-chief-ministers-arrest-in-graft-case/2034168/) | Reuters via ThePrint | 9 Apr 2024 | Kejriwal’s arrest and detention ahead of the election became a major case of graft enforcement that opposition parties saw as politically charged. Even if the graft allegations were real, the timing and pattern strengthen the view that enforcement was not cleanly insulated from politics. IDs: `5B.5`, `4B.9`.

- [Global watchdog calls on India to boost bank scrutiny for politicians, say sources](https://theprint.in/india/global-watchdog-calls-on-india-to-boost-bank-scrutiny-for-politicians-say-sources/2215827/) | Reuters via ThePrint | 9 Aug 2024 | FATF sources said India needed stronger monitoring of politicians, officials, and families as politically exposed persons. That is negative evidence that anti-money-laundering and capture controls were still not strong enough. IDs: `5B.5`, `5B.1`.

- [India's opposition calls for Adani probe, Modi's BJP questions timing of US indictment](https://theprint.in/india/indian-opposition-calls-for-adani-probe-modis-bjp-questions-timing-of-us-indictment/2367046/) | Reuters via ThePrint | 21 Nov 2024 | After Adani’s U.S. bribery indictment, opposition parties said the conglomerate had been protected by Modi’s government. This is allegation-based rather than proof, but it is still meaningful counterevidence of perceived oligarchic protection. IDs: `5B.5`, `5B.1`, `5B.4`.

- [Analysis-Modi's populism after India election reversal puts public finances at risk](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/analysismodis-populism-after-india-election-reversal-puts-public-finances-at-risk-3594854) | Reuters via Investing.com | 30 Aug 2024 | Reuters said Modi’s coalition stepped up cash handouts, debt waivers, and freebies after the election reversal to shore up political support. This is evidence of patronage-style politics rather than clean resistance to favoritism. IDs: `5B.5`, `5B.1`, `5B.3`.

**Search Gap**
- I found strong evidence on political finance opacity, donor concentration, and selective enforcement.
- I found weaker direct evidence of a positive Modi-led anti-corruption drive; most positive material is indirect, via competition enforcement and state-firm reform rather than explicit action against cronies or privileged firms.
